# Eclipse P2 update sites

<!-- Generated by tools/clientrecipes from src/p2.json; edit the source. -->

Read the [common setup and credential rules](README.md) first. [All recipes](index.md).

Client: **Eclipse Platform / Equinox P2 4.41, Java 21**. Registered classes: **remote, virtual**.

Endpoint: `${AW_URL}/artifactory/${AW_REPO}/`

## Before connecting

- An operator-approved anonymous READ policy on the particular remote/virtual repository, or a separately secured authenticating gateway operated for that client.
- A trusted HTTPS certificate and a compatible Eclipse installation unit.

Authentication: This headless director recipe uses an explicit server-side anonymous READ grant on the selected repository. Anonymous access is denied by default: an operator must enable anonymous access AND grant read permission to this repository. Do not grant write permission. No caller token is embedded in the repository URL. Private-user Eclipse secure-storage setup is not covered by this recipe.

Fresh client state: Create a new AW_WORK with mktemp -d for every run; client configuration, downloads and caches in the commands stay under this directory. Do not reuse it to prove a fresh download. Remove the temporary directory after use.

## Configure

Run the pinned Eclipse installation with a new configuration/workspace/destination. The server must explicitly authorize anonymous read on this repository, as described below.

```sh
umask 077
AW_WORK=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir -p "$AW_WORK/home"
mkdir -p "$AW_WORK/configuration" "$AW_WORK/workspace"
```

## Publish

No supported command. P2 supports remote and virtual repositories only. Publish the update site to its upstream source; this endpoint is a resolver/cache.

## Install or resolve

Classes: **remote, virtual**. Resolve through an operator-approved remote or virtual P2 site.

Select the installation unit/version appropriate to the site. The JVM must trust the HTTPS endpoint; use an operator-approved truststore for a private CA.

```sh
env HOME="$AW_WORK/home" eclipse -nosplash -consoleLog -configuration "$AW_WORK/configuration" -data "$AW_WORK/workspace" -application org.eclipse.equinox.p2.director -repository "$AW_URL/artifactory/$AW_REPO/" -installIU org.eclipse.glsp.layout.source/2.7.0 -destination "$AW_WORK/installed" -profile AWRecipe -p2.os linux -p2.ws gtk -p2.arch x86_64 -vmargs -Duser.home="$AW_WORK/home"
```

## Limits

Classes outside **remote, virtual** are not registered for this format. Commands above apply only to each operation's listed classes. Federated evidence is for one node; it does not establish cross-vendor replication.

- Local and federated P2 classes are unsupported.
- An anonymous grant makes the allowed repository content publicly readable; only use it for content the operator intends to expose.
- Earlier P2 tests used a TLS credential-injecting gateway; the explicit-grant recipe has a separate acceptance scenario.
